note: GFP recreation area on a peninsula in Lake Oahe, 17 mi NW of Pierre off SD 1804. The 18 primitive 'point' sites are scattered over the peninsula's fingers at the ends of gravel tracks, several right at the shoreline; boat ramp, group picnic shelter and walking trails. Between Oct. 1 and April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be shut off; vault toilets stay open. --Claude
